description: LT+MT DRC about the LT+1125K fit (MCTS node 35: 900-1125 K at +12.6 / -2.0 / -10.1 / -6.7 / -1.0 / +0.3 % of Lin): all 20 directions (16 reactions + 4 sticking coefficients), +-0.3 e-folds as in the earlier DRCs, 144 CRN-paired replicates, at the LT temperatures 900-1000 K and the MT temperatures 1025-1150 K (the paper text's MT range; 1150 can be dropped from the search later). The baseline arm is the fit's own growth rate at each temperature.
